Following that with light stretching or foam rolling may help you unwind physically. Keep your bedroom at a comfortable temperature to support restful, uninterrupted sleep.

Limiting screen use before bed and keeping the bedroom cool and dark may also improve sleep quality. Over time, consistent habits can make falling asleep easier.

Keeping your room cool and softly lit with a reading lamp can make the transition to sleep feel more peaceful.

- Examples: “Take the stairs twice today” or “Stretch for 10 minutes before bed.”
